title: astrapaea tiliifolia
intro: Astrapaea tiliifolia, commonly known as the Golden Pollen Orchid, is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Australia and New Guinea. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as asthma and bronchitis, due to its expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Astrapaea tiliifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may also contribute to its potential in treating other health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids and phenolic compounds, are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
